purpose: Shows and edits an organization's parent organization and units.
namedChanges: the imports are the peers': `CardGroup` from `card-group`; `useCardMode` from `card-mode`; `RemoveControl` from `remove-control`; `OrgMark` from `org-mark`; `OrgRecordPicker` and the type `OrgRecordHit` from `record-picker`; `OrgShortList`, the type `ListLabels`, `INLINE_EMPLOYEES`, `groupCountText`, `pagedFindBothSpellings`, `subjectSpellings` and `inVault` from `org-employees`; `resolveOrgTerms`, `refsOf`, `servedValue` and `resolveEmploymentLinkVocab` from `org-terms`; `patchRecord` and `readRecord` from `lws-records`; `findByAttribute`, `AttributeFindResult`, `mapWithConcurrency`, `MAX_PARALLEL_DEREFERENCES`, `listVaultRecordsPage`, `searchEntities` and `typeLocalName` from `lws-vault-sets`; `vaultOriginOf` from `vault-origin-rule`; `partyNameOf` from `stakeholder-card-model`; `idFromResourceUri` from `resource-id`; `termOrigin` from `term-origin`; the files of this unit import each other by `./name`;

the host constant becomes the setting (RuleGhsSettingUnit): `export const ORGANIZATION_TYPE_URI = `${GILBVEDA_MASTER_ORIGIN.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/base/t/Organization`;` is `export function organizationTypeUri(): string { return `${termOrigin().replace(/\/+$/, "")}/base/t/Organization`; }`, and `const ORGANIZATION_TYPE_NAME = typeLocalName(ORGANIZATION_TYPE_URI);` is `function organizationTypeName(): string { return typeLocalName(organizationTypeUri()); }` (not exported, as the constant was not); the four uses of `ORGANIZATION_TYPE_NAME` in `findOrganizationRecords` and `findByTypedSearch` are `organizationTypeName()`, read when the find runs;

`orgRecords.ts` no longer declares `OrgRecordHit` (source lines 60-72): the type is imported from `record-picker`, whose declaration differs only in `row?: PickerRow` where the source had `row?: BaseRecord` (`BaseRecord` is assignable to it; no code here sets `row`); the import of `BaseRecord` is gone, and this unit's entry point does not export `OrgRecordHit`;

`OrgHierarchySections.tsx`: the parent picker is given its find, `find={(text) => findOrganizationRecords(vaultId, text)}` (the source's `OrgRecordPicker` chose `findOrganizationRecords(vaultId, text)` itself when `find` was omitted; the unit `record-picker` has no default). Its query key is then the picker's own `["record-picker", "Parent organization", vaultId, text]` where the source's default was `["mynet", "org-records", vaultId, text]`, and the host gives the picker's query hook through `PickerQueryContext`;
comments only otherwise: cycle, agent, ticket and ruling tags, dates and person names are removed or reworded, and the 'Copied from MyNet' line of `orgHierarchy.ts`; no code changed.
